senses.gloss: इष् (I) vt. 1U (pp. एषित) To go.With अनु-, to follow.
इष् (II) vt. 4P (pp. इषित) 1. To go; 2. to spread.With अनु-, to search, to go in search of, न रत्नमन्विष्यति मृग्यते हि तत् K.S.v.45.With प्र-, to send, e.g. गत्वा प्रैषीच्च रावणम्.

इष् (III) vt. 6P (pp. इष्ट) (in conjugational tenses the base is इच्छ्) 1. To wish; 2. to cherish; 3. to choose.With अनु-, to search, to try.With अभि-, to desire.With परि-, to search.With प्रति-, to receive, to accept, ततः प्रतीच्छ प्रहरेति वादिनी Śrīharsha.
इस् ind. An interjection- (1) of anger; (2) of pain; (3) of sorrow.
ईश् vt. 2Ā (pp. ईशित) 1. To command, to rule; 2. to own, to possess (generally used with the gen., e.g. अर्थानामीशिषे त्वं वयमपि च गिरामीश्महे Bhartr.iii.30); 3. to be powerful.
ईष् vt. 1Ā (pp. ईषित) 1. To go, to move; 2. to kill; 3. to see.
